'''Coril Zimko''', also known as '''Neon Bantha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and forger. He was hired by [[Cavin Chistor]] to create a set of forged records linking [[Barnab Chistor]] and the [[Metatheran Cartel]] financially.
